mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4% in the month preceding the prediction triggers a risk-off reaction, lowering equity valuations and producing negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the prior month
regime_hint: high inflation or policy tightening anticipation
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the pre-trigger mean (p > 0.05) in 60 out of 60 test windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS (employment growth) exceeding 50,000 jobs signals labor market strength, which is associated with higher consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in at least 40% of such triggered periods (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO (industrial production index) over two consecutive months indicates supply-side weakness, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05) in 80% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (housing starts) surges by more than 10% month-over-month, it reflects robust construction activity and optimism about the economy, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >10% MoM in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite trigger (p < 0.05 in 3 out of 10 windows).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in UNRATE (unemployment rate) below 4% indicate labor market tightening, which raises policy patience and supports positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not positive in 70% of such triggered periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in RSAFS (retail sales) by over 5% suggests consumer weakness, which amplifies equity market volatility and produces negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls by >5% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 50% of triggered windows.

mechanism_narrative: When both INDPRO and GDPC1 show simultaneous declines over a 3-month window, it signals dual supply and demand softness, resulting in negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline over the previous 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) in 60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPIAUCSL (CPI) above 263 suggests accelerating inflation expectations, which typically precedes a rate hike and produces negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 40% of such triggers.
